notes: Fruit-drama pack stage 1 (plan 20, DEC-263): serial_60s_v2's beat shots told by one narrator, the telenovela shape of the reference fruit dramas. Fewer, longer body passages (3-5 body scenes of 10-16 s, 4 by default: 6 scenes on episode 1, 7 with the recap) in a 58-78 s window, tightening above 75 s; a body scene past max_shot_s is two beat shots. narrator_share is the narrator's share of the episode's words and character_lines the short character lines an episode carries (the only lines in frame, so the only ones lip-synced): E1v2 and E2 turn both into one ask line while the story's narrator is on. end_card_cta opts the end card into the call to action (stage 3). No BGM field: the template schema has no BGM hook, the style's emotion_to_mood picks the music (fruit_drama: telenovela_tension for tension, tropical_drama for tender).
